name: Heteroscedastic Gaussian and Asinh Composite Loss
definition: A composite training objective for neural tomography that combines a heteroscedastic Gaussian image loss and a fixed-scale asinh image loss to optimize density and temperature fields under observational noise.
summary: This training objective combines heteroscedastic Gaussian and fixed-scale asinh losses to optimize density and temperature fields, balancing pixel fidelity with noise robustness for physical consistency in neural tomography.
